elsewhere.note: When he had spent three months there, and a plot was made against him by Jews as he was about to set sail for Syria, he determined to return through Macedonia.
Now I beg you, brothers, through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you…
I give a judgment in this: for this is expedient for you who were the first to start a year ago, not only to do, but also to be willing.
But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.
These have one mind, and they give their power and authority to the beast.
